tgt: 你看，蹦极选手站在起跑点深吸一口气，然后像跳水一样，头朝下脚朝上，纵身一跃融入天地合一的境界，风在耳边呼啸，身体急速下降。还没来得及做几个体操动作，就被绳子反弹到高空。

src: 1 1 0</s>In 1986 , a New Zealander Hackett popularized Bungee as a commercialized sport of mass entertainment . This sport is very challenging . It is a test of people's psychological ability of endurance . Especially when descending , as if they are watching a fast forward tape and when they bounce back , they sway around . The timid people will shrink back at the sight of it . Even if they jump off , they find it hard to avoid screaming with closed eyes . No wonder people give the title ' brave ' to anyone who jumps off .</s>You see , the bungee participants take a deep breath when they stand at the starting spot and then , like diving , their heads are over heels and they jump off into the realm of the combination of heaven and earth The wind roars at their ears and their bodies rapidly descend . tgt: 一个法国小伙子回忆起他第一次蹦极的经历，他说，当我系好绳子走向跳台时，我非常紧张。我往下看的时候更紧张，如果绳子断了，我就完蛋了。但我知道我的担心是多余的。我怕自己退后别人会说我。所以只能一狠心，把头向下压。我只觉得耳边有风。我的身体迅速下降。我以为只过了七八秒我就被绳子弹到了高空。其实是30秒。可能是因为紧张，我只感觉到七八秒钟。当反弹到高空时，我突然有一种解脱的感觉。我不觉得紧张，反而很舒服。

Afterwards , I often put on a pot of coffee and get dressed while I wait for it to brew . I take a long time to get dressed in the morning . tgt: 大多数人认为财富意味着成功。但在我看来，这个问题应该从两个方面来看待。一方面，财富是衡量成功的一个非常重要的东西。赚钱的能力，在某种程度上意味着你的知识，你的能力，你劳动的价值等等。随着我国经济和工业的发展，越来越多的人现在追求金钱。在当代社会，如果你有钱，你似乎就拥有了一切。但事实并非如此。我认为成功另一方面也意味着从工作中得到满足。它也意味着你能从他人那里获得尊重。

With the development of our economy and industry , more and more people are pursuing money these days . And in toda / s society , If you have money , you seem to have everything . src: 8 1 0</s>China is now a member of world trade organization . As a member of TO , China will have to make some changes in its economic policies so that it can follow the routines practiced by other TO members . Is it fair to China , do you think ? <Zh>
tgt: 这是一个很难回答的问题，但我相信，重新审视中国过去的经济政策，可能会让我们找到正确的答案。新中国成立后，我国政府采取了许多经济政策来刺激中国经济的增长。然而，这点政策有利于我国企业，保护它们不受国际竞争的影响，对我国经济和国内企业的快速发展作出了巨大贡献。中国加入wto后，国内企业将需要与国外同行展开竞争。这种新形势要求中国经济政策发生一点变化。从长远来看，这点变化将促使中国企业增强竞争力。

src: 8 1 0</s>China is now a member of world trade organization . As a member of TO , China will have to make some changes in its economic policies so that it can follow the routines practiced by other TO members . Is it fair to China , do you think ?</s>It's a hard question , but I'm sure the reexamination of China's economic policies in the past may lead us to a right answer to the question . After the establishment of new China , our government employed numerous economics policies to stimulate the growth of China's economy . These policies , however , favored our domestic enterprises and protected them from international competition and these policies have contributed a lot to the rapid growth of both China economy and our domestic enterprises . After China's entry into TO , Chinese domestic enterprises will have to compete with their foreign counterparts . This new situation entails some changes of Chinese economic policies . These changes will spur Chinese enterprises to strengthen their competitiveness in the long run .</s>We can infer that the non-discrimination principle is one of the most important principles of TO agreement . This principle requires equal treatment of domestic and foreign enterprise . Does the principle also apply to domestic enterprise of different ownerships ? <Zh>
tgt: 是的，不同所有制的国内企业享有平等的权利，因为不歧视原则赋予企业平等的权利，而不论其国籍和所有制。我发现，虽然中国经济政策的变化是多方面的，但这点变化很大程度上是基于最重要的经济原则，即协议不歧视原则。对这点变化规律的认识，不仅有助于我们深刻认识这点变化，而且有助于我们预见中国经济政策新变化的趋势。
